annotation.justification: The clause provides a clear directive for when an origin server should send a Vary header field. It specifies the conditions under which the Vary header should be used (when representation selection varies based on request aspects other than method and request target) and when it may be omitted (if variance cannot be crossed or if configured to prevent cache transparency). The language is prescriptive and does not allow for multiple materially different interpretations that would affect implementation behavior.
